# Tata Motors posts Q2 profit on strong commercial vehicle demand

Reuters

Published23 Oct 2026, 04:46 PM IST

India's Tata Motors on Friday posted a quarterly profit compared to a loss a year earlier, helped by healthy demand for commercial vehicles.

The automaker reported a profit of 21.38 billion rupees ($225.19 million) for the July to September quarter, compared with a loss of 10.21 billion rupees a year earlier. The profit included a one-time gain of 2.18 billion rupees.
